message.content: Niamh reflects on Jaime Lannister's character arc and suggests that if Jaime had remained true to the lessons he learned from Brienne of Tarth, he might have ended up with a more fulfilling and less tragic conclusion. Specifically, Niamh proposes that Jaime could have chosen to step away from Cersei completely, allowing him to embrace his new values and avoid falling back into his old ways. This scenario would have allowed Jaime to become a true protector of the realm, rather than one who continually faced internal conflict and external pressures. Niamh believes that by fully embracing his growth and lessons, Jaime could have achieved a state of genuine redemption and happiness, avoiding the bitter ending he ultimately experienced.
